Sandbox_RainingZombies_FallDamageReducti: How much health zombies recover after hitting the ground. 100 = completely immune to fall damage. 0 = they take full vanilla fall damage.
Sandbox_RainingZombies_InstantGlassShatt: If checked, zombies pushed against closed windows will instantly shatter the glass and fall through. If unchecked, they will get stuck until the glass is broken normally.
Sandbox_RainingZombies_HordeThrottle_too: Controls the flow of falling zombies to protect CPU performance. 15 frames is recommended. Lower numbers create a faster waterfall effect but require a stronger processor.
Sandbox_RainingZombies_PlayerKnockdown_t: If checked, players will be knocked down if a falling zombie lands directly on their tile.
Sandbox_RainingZombies_PlayerDamagePerFl: Calculates how much health damage a player takes when crushed. The number is multiplied by the height of the fall. (Default 20 damage x 3 floors = 60 total damage).
Sandbox_RainingZombies_PlayerFractures_t: If checked, zombies falling from high altitudes will cause fractures to the player on impact. Drops from higher floors cause multiple fractures. Limbs are randomly selected to fracture.
Sandbox_RainingZombies_CrawlerConversion: If checked, falling zombies that survive a 2 floor impact, or more, will become crawlers.
Sandbox_RainingZombies_ZombieChainReacti: If checked, falling zombies will physically crash into zombies on the street, knocking them down
Sandbox_RainingZombies_AudioVisualPolish: If checked, falling bodies will trigger bone-breaking audio and paint the pavement with blood based on how far they fell.
